mock_data.title: Travel Troubles
mock_data.passage:
Every year, it seems, more and more people are going on holiday abroad. Alas, this means that more and more people are also experiencing the discomfort and frustration of foreign travel. This often starts at the airport, irrespective of which airline you are using.

At least at peak holiday times, there are bound to be queues at the check-in and then more queues at passport control as you go into the departure lounge. Then, there is often the misery of delayed flights. These tend to be more common if you are travelling by charter flight, but they are by no means unknown on scheduled flights.

Sometimes such delays are due to technical hitches or to the very large numbers of planes which now take off and land. However, some, in Europe at least, are the result of industrial action by staff. The holiday season is a favourite time for baggage handlers, air-traffic control personnel, or other airport staff to take such action.

Still, eventually you get to the departure gate, board the plane, find your seat and fasten your seat belt ready for take-off. Members of the cabin crew will very likely serve you with food and drink and, unless you are on a long-haul flight, it will seem a relatively short time before you land.

Now it is time to follow the signs to the baggage reclaim area of the airport and wait by the carousel for your luggage, hoping that it has not been left behind or been sent to the wrong airport. Not surprisingly, given the amount of luggage that is taken on board planes by travellers, it is quite common for luggage to go missing.

Fortunately, this is usually a temporary state of affairs. The individual pieces of luggage are tagged, making it relatively easy for airlines to track them. Still, it is always a relief when you are reunited with your possessions! It is even more of a relief to get home and we are often left wondering if travel is really worth the effort. Next year, however, will find us at the airport again.
mock_data.passageB1:
Every year, more people go on holiday to other countries. But, this also means that more people have problems when they travel abroad. These problems often start at the airport.

No matter which airline you use, there are usually long queues at check-in. Then, you have to wait again at passport control before you can go to the departure lounge. Often, flights are delayed. This means your flight leaves later than planned. This happens more often with charter flights, but it can also happen with normal flights.

Sometimes, delays are because of problems with the plane, or because there are too many planes taking off and landing. In Europe, some delays are because workers like air-traffic control staff are on strike. They do this to ask for better pay or working conditions. The holiday time is often when they choose to strike.

Finally, you get to your departure gate, get on the plane, find your seat, and fasten your seat belt. The people who work on the plane, the cabin crew, will give you food and drinks. If it is not a very long flight, you will land quite soon.

When you land, you need to follow the signs to the baggage reclaim area. Here, you wait for your luggage to come on the carousel. You hope your luggage has not been lost or sent to the wrong airport. Because so many people take luggage on planes, it is common for luggage to go missing.

Luckily, this is usually only for a short time. The bags have tags on them, so the airlines can usually find them. It is a good feeling when you get your bags back! It is even better to get home. Sometimes we ask ourselves if travelling is worth the effort. But next year, we will probably be at the airport again!
mock_data.passageB2:
More and more people seem to be jetting off abroad for their holidays each year. However, this also means that an increasing number of travellers are facing the inevitable stresses and disappointments that can come with international travel. The problems often begin at the airport, regardless of which airline you're flying with.

Especially during peak season, you're virtually guaranteed to encounter long queues at check-in, followed by further delays at passport control before you can even reach the departure lounge. Then, there's the often agonising experience of flight delays. While these are more likely with charter flights, scheduled flights are by no means immune. These delays can be caused by technical problems or the sheer volume of aircraft taking off and landing. However, in Europe, at least, some are due to industrial action by airport staff. Unfortunately, the holiday season is often a popular time for baggage handlers, air traffic controllers, or other airport employees to take industrial action.

Despite these potential setbacks, you eventually make it to the departure gate, board the plane, find your seat, and buckle up, ready for take-off. The cabin crew will probably serve you food and drinks, and unless you're on a long-haul flight, the journey will seem relatively short before you land.

Upon arrival, you need to follow the signs to the baggage reclaim area and wait by the carousel for your luggage, hoping it hasn't been mislaid or sent to the wrong destination. With the sheer amount of luggage carried on planes, it's unfortunately quite common for bags to go missing. Luckily, this is usually a temporary situation. Luggage is tagged, making it relatively easy for airlines to track it down. Still, it's always a relief to be reunited with your belongings! It's an even greater relief to arrive home safe and sound, leaving us to ponder whether the trip was worth the effort. However, next year will almost certainly find us back at the airport, ready for another adventure, come what may.
mock_data.passageC1:
The seemingly inexorable rise in international tourism each year, while undoubtedly broadening horizons, also begets a corresponding increase in the trials and tribulations inherent in modern air travel. From the outset, the airport experience, regardless of the carrier, often proves to be a crucible of frustration. One is invariably confronted with serpentine queues at check-in, followed by the inevitable bottleneck at passport control before even reaching the relative sanctuary of the departure lounge.

Flight delays, a common bugbear of travellers, further compound the issue. While charter flights are particularly susceptible to such disruptions, scheduled services are by no means immune. These delays can stem from a multitude of factors, including unforeseen technical malfunctions or the sheer volume of air traffic navigating increasingly congested skies. However, in Europe, at least, a significant proportion can be attributed to industrial action, with the peak holiday season often serving as a strategic moment for baggage handlers, air-traffic controllers, and other airport personnel to leverage their bargaining power.

Eventually, however, one manages to navigate the labyrinthine corridors to the departure gate, board the aircraft, and locate one's designated seat, buckling up in anticipation of the imminent take-off. The cabin crew, with practised efficiency, will likely dispense refreshments, and, barring particularly long-haul journeys, the flight itself passes relatively swiftly. Upon arrival, the next hurdle presents itself: the often-agonising wait at the baggage reclaim carousel, fraught with the anxiety that one's luggage may have been inadvertently misdirected or, worse still, left behind altogether. Given the sheer volume of baggage processed daily, it is hardly surprising that instances of misplaced luggage are relatively commonplace.

Fortunately, such occurrences are generally temporary. The sophisticated tagging systems employed by airlines facilitate the tracing of individual items, and the eventual reunion with one's belongings is invariably met with considerable relief. Indeed, the ultimate arrival back home often evokes a sense of profound gratitude, prompting the perennial question of whether the entire ordeal was truly worth the candle. Yet, come what may, the allure of distant shores seems irresistible, and the following year will inevitably find us once more navigating the chaotic landscape of the airport, ready to brave the elements of modern travel.

mock_data.translation:
Har yili, ko'proq odamlar chet elga dam olishga ketayotganga o'xshaydi. Afsuski, bu ko'proq odamlar chet elga sayohat qilishning noqulayligi va umidsizliklarini (frustration) ham boshdan kechirayotganliklarini anglatadi. Bu ko'pincha qaysi aviakompaniyadan (airline) foydalanayotganingizdan qat'i nazar, aeroportdan boshlanadi.

Hech bo'lmaganda dam olish kunlarining eng qizg'in (peak) vaqtlarida, ro'yxatdan o'tish (check-in) joyida navbatlar, keyin esa kutish zaliga (departure lounge) kirayotganingizda pasport nazoratida (passport control) yana navbatlar bo'lishi muqarrar. Keyin, ko'pincha kechiktirilgan reyslarning azobi paydo bo'ladi. Agar siz charter reys (charter flight) bilan sayohat qilayotgan bo'lsangiz, bular ko'proq uchraydi, ammo bular muntazam reyslarda (scheduled flights) ham begona emas.

Ba'zida bunday kechikishlar texnik nosozliklar (technical hitches) yoki hozirda havoga ko'tarilayotgan (take off) va qo'nayotgan samolyotlarning juda ko'pligi bilan bog'liq. Biroq, ba'zilari, hech bo'lmaganda Evropada, xodimlarning ish tashlashi (industrial action) natijasidir. Ta'til mavsumi yuk tashuvchilar (baggage handlers), havo harakatini boshqarish xodimlari (air-traffic control personnel) yoki boshqa aeroport xodimlari uchun bunday choralarni ko'rish uchun sevimli vaqtdir.

Shunday bo'lsa-da, oxir-oqibat siz chiqish darvozasiga (departure gate) yetib borasiz, samolyotga chiqasiz (board), o'z o'rningizni topasiz va havoga ko'tarilishga (take-off) tayyor holda xavfsizlik kamarini bog'laysiz. Samolyot xodimlari (cabin crew) sizga katta ehtimol bilan oziq-ovqat va ichimliklar tortiq qilishadi va agar siz uzoq masofali reysda (long-haul flight) bo'lmasangiz, qo'nguningizcha nisbatan qisqa vaqt o'tgandek tuyuladi.

Endi aeroportning yuklarni qayta olish (baggage reclaim) joyidagi belgilarga ergashish va yuklaringizni (luggage) kutish uchun konveyer tasmasi (carousel) yonida kutish vaqti keldi, yuklar ortda qolib ketmaganiga yoki noto'g'ri aeroportga yuborilmaganiga umid qilasiz. Ajablanarli emaski, sayohatchilar tomonidan samolyot bortiga olingan yuklarning miqdorini hisobga olsak, yuklarning yo'qolishi odatiy holdir.

Yaxshiyamki, bu odatda vaqtinchalik holat. Yuklarning alohida qismlari belgilanadi (tagged), bu aviakompaniyalarga ularni kuzatishni (track) nisbatan osonlashtiradi. Shunday bo'lsa-da, narsalaringiz bilan yana jamoat bo'lganingizda har doim taskin topasiz! Uyga yetib borish yanada katta yengillik va biz ko'pincha sayohat haqiqatan ham shuncha harakatga arziydimi deb hayron qolamiz. Kelasi yili esa bizni yana aeroportda topishadi.

mock_data.translationB1:
Har yili ko'proq odamlar boshqa davlatlarga ta'tilga boradilar. Ammo, bu shuni anglatadiki, ko'proq odamlar chet elga sayohat qilganda muammolarga duch kelishadi. Bu muammolar ko'pincha aeroportda boshlanadi.

Qaysi aviakompaniyadan foydalanishingizdan qat'iy nazar, ro'yxatdan o'tishda odatda uzun navbatlar bo'ladi. Keyin, jo'nash zaliga o'tishdan oldin pasport nazoratida yana kutishingiz kerak. Ko'pincha, reyslar kechikadi. Bu sizning reysingiz rejalashtirilganidan kechroq uchishini anglatadi. Bu charter reyslar bilan ko'proq sodir bo'ladi, lekin oddiy reyslar bilan ham sodir bo'lishi mumkin.

Ba'zan, kechikishlar samolyot bilan bog'liq muammolar tufayli yoki juda ko'p samolyotlar uchayotgani va qo'nayotgani sababli yuzaga keladi. Yevropada ba'zi kechikishlar havo harakatini nazorat qilish xodimlari kabi ishchilarning ish tashlashi tufayli yuzaga keladi. Ular buni yaxshiroq maosh yoki ish sharoitlarini so'rash uchun qilishadi. Ta'til vaqti ko'pincha ular ish tashlashni tanlaydigan vaqt bo'ladi.

Nihoyat, siz o'z jo'nash darvozangizga yetib borasiz, samolyotga o'tirasiz, o'z o'rningizni topasiz va xavfsizlik kamarini taqasiz. Samolyotda ishlaydigan odamlar, ekipaj sizga ovqat va ichimliklar beradi. Agar bu juda uzoq reys bo'lmasa, siz tez orada qo'nasiz.

Qo'nganingizdan so'ng, siz yuklarni qaytarib olish joyiga yo'l ko'rsatuvchi belgilarga amal qilishingiz kerak. Bu yerda siz yuklaringiz karruselga kelishini kutasiz. Sizning yuklaringiz yo'qolmagan yoki noto'g'ri aeroportga yuborilmagan deb umid qilasiz. Juda ko'p odamlar samolyotlarda yuk olib yurgani sababli, yuklarning yo'qolishi odatiy holdir.

Yaxshiyamki, bu odatda qisqa vaqtga cho'ziladi. Sumkalarda yoriqlar bor, shuning uchun aviakompaniyalar ularni odatda topa oladilar. Sumkalaringizni qaytarib olganingizda, yaxshi his-tuyg'u paydo bo'ladi! Uyga qaytish undan ham yaxshiroq. Ba'zan biz sayohat qilish harakatga arziydimi deb o'zimizdan so'raymiz. Ammo kelgusi yili biz yana aeroportda bo'lishimiz mumkin!
mock_data.translationB2:
Yildan-yilga ko'proq odamlar ta'til uchun xorijga uchib ketayotganga o'xshaydi. Biroq, bu shuni anglatadiki, xalqaro sayohat bilan kelishi mumkin bo'lgan muqarrar stress va umidsizliklarga duch kelayotgan sayohatchilar soni ham ortib bormoqda. Muammolar ko'pincha aeroportda boshlanadi, qaysi aviakompaniya bilan uchishingizdan qat'i nazar.

Ayniqsa, eng qizg'in mavsumda, ro'yxatdan o'tish joylarida uzun navbatlarga duch kelishingiz deyarli kafolatlanadi, so'ngra hatto jo'nash zaliga yetib borguningizcha pasport nazoratida qo'shimcha kechikishlar bo'ladi. Keyin, parvozning kechikishi kabi ko'pincha azobli tajriba bor. Charter reyslarda bu ehtimol ko'proq bo'lsa-da, rejalashtirilgan reyslar ham immunitetga ega emas. Bu kechikishlar texnik muammolar yoki havoga ko'tarilayotgan va qo'nayotgan samolyotlarning soni ko'pligi sabab bo'lishi mumkin. Biroq, Yevropada, hech bo'lmaganda, ba'zilari aeroport xodimlarining ish tashlashi tufayli yuzaga keladi. Afsuski, ta'til mavsumi ko'pincha yuk tashuvchilar, havo harakati nazoratchilari yoki boshqa aeroport xodimlarining ish tashlashi uchun mashhur vaqtdir.

Ushbu potentsial qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, siz oxir-oqibat jo'nash darvozasiga yetib borasiz, samolyotga chiqasiz, o'rningizni topasiz va kamarini bog'lab, havoga ko'tarilishga tayyor bo'lasiz. Kabin ekipaji sizga ovqat va ichimliklar taqdim etishi mumkin va agar siz uzoq masofali reysda bo'lmasangiz, qo'nguncha sayohat nisbatan qisqa bo'lib tuyuladi.

Kelgandan so'ng, siz yukni qaytarib olish joyiga ishoralar bo'yicha borishingiz va o'z yukingiz uchun karusel yonida kutishingiz kerak, u yo'qolmagan yoki noto'g'ri manzilga yuborilmagan bo'lishiga umid qilasiz. Samolyotlarda olib ketiladigan yuklarning soni ko'pligi sababli, yuklarning yo'qolishi afsuski juda keng tarqalgan. Yaxshiyamki, bu odatda vaqtinchalik holat. Yuklar teg bilan belgilanadi, bu aviakompaniyalarga uni topishni nisbatan osonlashtiradi. Shunga qaramay, o'z narsalaringiz bilan qayta uchrashish har doim xursandchilik keltiradi! Uyga sog'-salomat kelish yanada katta xursandchilik, bu bizni sayohatga arziydimi yoki yo'qmi deb o'ylashga majbur qiladi. Biroq, kelasi yili bizni deyarli albatta aeroportda yana bir sarguzashtga tayyor holda topamiz, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar.

Har yili xalqaro turizmning tobora o'sib borishi, shubhasiz, ufqni kengaytirsa-da, zamonaviy havo transportida mavjud bo'lgan muammolar va sinovlarning ham shunga mos ravishda ko'payishiga sabab bo'ladi. Dastlab, aeroportdagi tajriba, aviakompaniyaning qaysi ekanligidan qat'i nazar, ko'pincha umidsizlik o'chog'i bo'lib chiqadi. Doimo ro'yxatdan o'tishda ilon izi kabi navbatlarga duch kelasiz, so'ngra parvoz zalining nisbiy panohiga yetib borguncha pasport nazoratida to'xtab qolish muqarrar.

Parvozning kechikishi, sayohatchilarning umumiy dardidir, bu muammoni yanada og'irlashtiradi. Charter reyslari bunday uzilishlarga ayniqsa moyil bo'lsa-da, rejalashtirilgan reyslar ham bundan mustasno emas. Bu kechikishlar ko'plab omillarga bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin, jumladan, kutilmagan texnik nosozliklar yoki tobora gavjum osmonda harakatlanayotgan havo transportining haddan tashqari ko'pligi. Biroq, Yevropada, hech bo'lmaganda, sezilarli qismi sanoat harakatlari bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin, bunda eng yuqori ta'til mavsumi ko'pincha yuk tashuvchilar, havo harakatini boshqaruvchilar va boshqa aeroport xodimlari uchun o'z savdolashish imkoniyatlaridan foydalanish uchun strategik vaqt bo'lib xizmat qiladi.

Oxir-oqibat, odam labirint koridorlaridan parvoz darvozasiga o'tib, samolyotga chiqib, o'z joyini topadi va yaqinlashib kelayotgan parvozni kutib, xavfsizlik kamarini taqadi. Salon ekipaji tajribali samaradorlik bilan ichimliklar tarqatadi va uzoq masofali reyslardan tashqari, parvozning o'zi nisbatan tez o'tadi. Yetib kelgandan so'ng, keyingi to'siq paydo bo'ladi: yukni qaytarish karuselida ko'pincha azobli kutish, yukingiz tasodifan noto'g'ri yo'naltirilgan yoki undan ham yomoni, umuman qoldirilgan degan tashvish bilan to'la. Har kuni qayta ishlanadigan yuklarning hajmini hisobga olsak, yo'qolgan yuklarning holatlari nisbatan keng tarqalgani ajablanarli emas.

Yaxshiyamki, bunday holatlar odatda vaqtinchalik bo'ladi. Aviakompaniyalar tomonidan qo'llaniladigan murakkab teglash tizimlari alohida narsalarni kuzatishni osonlashtiradi va o'z narsalari bilan oxirgi qayta uchrashuv doimo katta yengillik bilan kutib olinadi. Haqiqatan ham, uyga oxirgi yetib kelish ko'pincha chuqur minnatdorchilik hissini uyg'otadi va butun azob chindan ham arzirdimi degan doimiy savolni keltirib chiqaradi. Ammo, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, uzoq qirg'oqlarning jozibasi qarshilik ko'rsatib bo'lmaydigan tuyuladi va kelgusi yilda biz yana aeroportning tartibsiz manzarasida harakatlanamiz, zamonaviy sayohatning qiyinchiliklariga bardosh berishga tayyormiz.
